### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Python wrapper around sox. [Read the Docs here](http://pysox.readthedocs.org). This library was presented in the following paper: [R. M. Bittner](https://github.com/rabitt), [E. J. Humphrey](https://github.com/ejhumphrey) and J. P. Bello, "[pysox: Leveraging the Audio Signal Processing Power of SoX in Python](https://wp.nyu.edu/ismir2016/wp-content/uploads/sites/2294/2016/08/bittner-pysox.pdf)", in Proceedings of the 17th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference Late Breaking and Demo Papers, New York City, USA, Aug. 2016.
